# Documentation, Evidence, Release, and Submission Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System — URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the delivery requirements (domains 15 Documentation, 17 GitHub evidence, 18 Release readiness, 19 Assessment submission)
**Created**: 2026-09-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md §13–§14](../plan.md) · [gate register](../../../docs/governance/human-gate-register.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Tags**: `[Mandatory]` / `[Enhancement]`; `Detects:` names the guide failure trap an item guards against.

## Documentation

- [ ] CHK001 Are the documentation deliverables enumerated (README, architecture overview, ADRs, scenario docs, setup, testing approach, limitations, trade-offs, final summary, reviewer guide)? [Completeness, A§5] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK002 Is documentation required to change in the same task group as the behavior it describes, with a defined consistency check? [Consistency, Constitution X, Plan §9 DOC-001] Detects: documentation inconsistent with behavior. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the quickstart required to be validated from a clean clone with recorded results? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, ADR-014] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK004 Are known limitations and trade-offs required to be listed with mitigations or backlog items? [Completeness, research.md deferred backlog, Plan §14] [Mandatory]

## GitHub Evidence

- [ ] CHK005 Are commit conventions and the one-coherent-change-per-commit rule defined? [Clarity, Constitution Development Workflow] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK006 Is commit history required to reflect the actual execution sequence (no manufactured TDD commits)? [Clarity, Constitution X] Detects: fabricated results. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK007 Is disclosure of AI co-authorship required in commits? [Completeness, Constitution X] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the handling of classified source documents recorded (assignment brief not committed)? [Assumption, Spec §Input note] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the final tag and its preconditions (clean tree, reviewer instructions validated from a fresh checkout) specified? [Completeness, gate G7] [Enhancement]

## Release Readiness

- [ ] CHK010 Are the three readiness outcomes defined with exhaustive, non-overlapping criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-RDY-01, Plan §9] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK011 Is readiness specified to remain `NOT READY` while any mandatory human gate is unratified? [Consistency, Constitution Governance, Plan §14] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK012 Must residual risks be disclosed with owners before the release decision? [Completeness, Constitution XI] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK013 Is it specified who decides repository release readiness (G6) versus release inside a run (`RELEASE_APPROVAL`)? [Clarity, Plan §5, gate register] [Mandatory]

## Assessment Submission

- [ ] CHK014 Is every assignment deliverable (A§5) mapped to a repository location? [Traceability, A§5] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the final engineering summary required to follow the guide's 21-section schema in order? [Completeness, guide §25] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK016 Must every material claim in the summary cite a path, an identifier, a command, and an observable result? [Measurability, guide §25] Detects: unsupported completion claims. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the reviewer navigation guide required to cover all 25 items of the guide's navigation prompt? [Completeness, guide §26] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK018 Are pending human decisions required to be presented separately from engineering evidence in the submission? [Clarity, gate register, Plan §14] [Mandatory]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- Review owner: the human candidate (Gates G5/G6/G7)
